description: Shared Renovate preset for context-and-oss/cicd consumers.
Three pin shapes — use whichever matches how your repo calls the pipeline:
1. GitHub Actions reusable-workflow ref  ← simplest, GitHub CI only
Tracked automatically by Renovate's built-in github-actions manager.
Use this when you want the full pre-wired pipeline with zero Dagger knowledge.
2. Dagger -m flag in a pipeline YAML  ← ADO, Jenkins, or manual Dagger invocation
Tracked by the yaml-dagger-module custom manager below.
Use this when you're not on GitHub Actions or need to pass custom flags.
3. dagger.json source pin  ← power users composing their own pipeline
Tracked by the dagger-json-module custom manager below.
Use this when you pick individual modules and wire them yourself.
To enable: add one line to your repo's renovate.json:

customManagers.description: Dagger -m module pins in pipeline YAML files (ADO, Jenkins, etc.)
Dagger module source pins in dagger.json (custom pipeline composition)
